description: Capability for the dreamcontext Assistant notch (label `assistant`). It drives OTHER windows — opens project windows, moves and sizes them for tiling, focuses them, rings their doorbell with a targeted event — so it gets window creation, geometry and emit-to. Deliberately NO shell:* (it renders agent-authored markdown and HTML like every chat pane) and no clipboard or dialogs it does not use; the one dialog it does use is the native file/folder picker (`allow-pick-paths`) behind the composer's Attach menu. The doorbell carries only a single-use command id; the receiving window claims the real command from the server with its own nonce (see src/server/routes/assistant.ts), so emit-to here cannot forge a command. Pop out / dock: it emits `assistant://seat` (a plain emit, heard only by the Rust side in src/assistant.rs), moves itself by start-dragging from its top row, and reads its own size and position (core:window:default) so a docked window pops out where it was.
